text:
```yaml
name: Close PRs Targeting Unready Issues

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - edited

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  close-unready-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      issues: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github
      - uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd # v8.0.0
        with:
          retries: 3
          script: |
            const script = require(
              `${process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.github/workflows/unready-pr.js`
            );
            await script({ context, github });
```
